title: AI chip cooling shifts to diamond copper, but machining remains a major bottleneck
html:
Rising thermal design power and expanding die sizes in AI server chips are pushing thermal architectures from two thermal interface material (TIM) layers down to one, while driving a material shift from traditional copper to diamond copper...

Credit: DIGITIMES
